svg.title: Godstorm Eclipse — Throne of the Black Sun. Draft 2 / Godstorm Eclipse classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Black Sun Rising forks into Hammer of the Heavens then Total Eclipse, or Charged Firmament then Lingering Corona. Stormgod's Marrow forks into Obsidian Skin then Pillar of Heaven, or Devouring Eclipse then Eater of Suns. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Godstorm Eclipse jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Five of its twelve jutsu carry a Damage row (Raijin's Cage 50; Storm-God's Heart, Black Sun Cataract and Corona Devourer Palm 45; Obsidian Tomb 40, all 60 AP on a 7-round cooldown), so burst is the primary emphasis and the deepest raw-power route. Godstorm Mantle: Tempest is the sustain engine (Afterburn 35%, Lifesteal 40% and IDG 35% on one 40 AP cast) and anchors both the lifesteal and the burn routes, while Event Horizon Gate and Thunder-Crowned Bulwark carry the two DDT rows that anchor the tank route. IDG (four self-buff rows) and IDT (three enemy-debuff rows) are confined to Foundation 01 and to capstone secondaries so no capstone duplicates a sibling Hidden Art and every full-budget allocation stays non-dominated."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Black Sun Rising","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"The eclipse crowns the storm, and whatever it looks upon is laid bare.","coverage_note":"IDG 35% on Wall, Tempest, Bulwark and Marrow Mantle (self, 2 rounds); IDT 35% on Gate (ally hazard), Wall and Storm-God's Heart.","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Godstorm Eclipse","scope":"Godstorm Eclipse jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Event Horizon Gate","Godstorm Mantle: Sky-Splitting Wall","Godstorm Mantle: Storm-God's Heart","Godstorm Mantle: Tempest","Godstorm Mantle: Thunder-Crowned Bulwark","Marrow Eclipse Mantle"],"effect_rows":7,"ally_hazard_rows":["Event Horizon Gate#1"],"item_gated_rows":7}},{"id":"02","name":"Hammer of the Heavens","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":2,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"Thunder is not a sound. Suns"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: two Foundations each fork into two Hidden -> Advanced routes mapping onto the four non-glue tags and the traits: Damage (Burst Heavy, 5 rows), Afterburn (pressure, Tempest row 0), DDT (Tank, Gate and Bulwark) and Lifesteal (Sustain, Tempest row 1). IDG and IDT appear only on Foundation 01 and as capstone secondaries, never on a Hidden Art, and Eater of Suns' +2 Afterburn sits below Charged Firmament's +3, so all 14 full-budget allocations are non-dominated and every node is used.","Reference reuse: Black Sun Rising, Hammer of the Heavens, Total Eclipse and Charged Firmament copy Taiyo Kami's Dawnheart, Crown of Cinders, Solar Cataclysm and Emberwake flats verbatim, and Lingering Corona is Eternal Noon minus its +3 IDG. The shape fits: the kit has Taiyo's burst, Afterburn, IDG/IDT and DDT rows. Departures: Lifesteal replaces DDG (no DDG rows here); the DDT route is +2/+2/+3 = +7 (Taiyo +10) because it reaches two rows; IDG reaches four rows, so its maximum stays +5 (01+08).","Calibration: per-row Damage gains match Taiyo (+5 is +10-12.5% on 40-50 power rows), but Damage +5 reaches five rows (row-weighted 25, Taiyo 15) and the strongest build (01+02+03+06) is 45 against Taiyo's 31, or 2.8 vs 3.4 per supported row (16 vs 9). User-owned options: Total Eclipse +3 (full route Tomb 45, Heart/Cataract/Palm 50, Cage 55) or +2 (44/49/54; the maximum then moves to 43, 01+02+04+05); DDT route +7 or Taiyo's +10; whether Black Sun Rising keeps IDT given the Gate ally hazard.","Passives: the bloodline IDG passive (25% + 0.15/level on seven elements incl. None, Shadow, Storm) multiplies the enhanced Damage rows, while kit IDG/IDT/DDT rows add power/100 of the staged base (\u00a73b). The four IDG self buffs carry no element ('Highest' stats; Bulwark all four), so they also raise basic attacks, weapons and element-less jutsu; the three IDT debuffs raise allies' hits on that enemy. Lifesteal counts the Verdicts' pierce hits; Afterburn, IDG, IDT and DDT skip pierce.","Delivery and uptime: all 12 jutsu are item-gated (Eclipse Marrow, Godstorm Aegis; see risks); cooldowns are 7 rounds, damage rows cost 60 AP, buff casts 40 AP. Every DDT, IDG and Lifesteal row lands on the caster at cast and is live the two rounds after, wherever it stands (\u00a73b, \u00a74b): Gate's DDT and Bulwark's IDG/DDT are SELF rows, not circle or tile effects (Bulwark's only positional row is its unsupported move). No buff helps a hit in its cast round. Ranked modes skip skill effects.","Fourth purchases: after any 3 BP route the natural fourth is the other Foundation; four examples, one per capstone and trait. Pillar of Heaven (01+06+07+08) is the only IDG +5 build and one of two at DDT +7 (with 06+07+08+09), mirroring Sovereign Sun's +5 DDT/+3 IDG; accepted because it holds no Damage power and its IDG is four 40 AP self buffs (option: shift part of it to Eater of Suns). Also legal: 01+02+04+05 (strongest burn), 06+07+09+10 (tank-sustain), 01+02+06+09 (no-capstone hybrid)."],"risks":["Classification: Shadow and Storm both sit on the kit's damage rows and neither is exclusive in the census (Shadow: Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Oblivion Seal, Shadow Weaver, Night Parade and deferred/excluded kits; Storm: Arashima, Shinrai Ou, Stormboat Willy), so a bloodline-keyed classification extension is required, not a bare element label. Non-bloodline jutsu carrying Shadow or Storm: unverified.","Resolver: 11 of the 16 supported rows carry no element and fall back to None under the current resolver; affectedElements=['Shadow'] matches only 3 rows directly and ['Storm'] only 2. Reaching the rest today would need None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. The tree assumes the proposed whole-kit classification.","Ally hazard (validator warns): Gate row 1 IDT (friendly fire none; raised by 01, 05) lands once at cast on every non-caster user in its radius-1 circle, so allies there take it for two rounds; the caster never does, and Gate's SELF DDT offsets nothing (\u00a74b). Corona Palm row 0 Damage (raised by 02, 03) is a GROUND spiral of radius 4 around the caster, own tile excluded, hitting allies on its tiles.","Item gates (all supported rows): Eclipse Marrow (ZaTCUYIgRUoB2CBRo7pLY) gates Gate, Tomb, Midnight Verdict, Corona Palm, Marrow Mantle, Cataract; Godstorm Aegis (g0hPGnF9lLYauTsjxqpAZ) the six Godstorm Mantle jutsu (answers/names_item.json). Gating is uniform (no per-tag down-weighting); Eclipse Marrow alone loses Tempest's two routes, Godstorm Aegis alone keeps 2 Damage rows and 1 DDT row.","Lifesteal: the route tops out at 50%, ten points under the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage leech budget shared with vamp; vamp from the normal tree or items can saturate the cap and waste part of the +10. It needs both combatants alive and is blocked by healprevent on the caster. Pierce hits (Heavenbreaker 60, Midnight Verdict 66) feed lifesteal at full ratio: the sustain route's unlisted upside.","Afterburn: the +10 route is one application row on a single-target 40 AP cast; its value is downstream on every non-pierce hit that one enemy takes for two rounds, capped at 60% of each hit, so other Afterburn sources saturate quickly, and the kit's own pierce Verdicts never feed it. Not simulated.","Stacking: BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin, so these modifiers stack with other potency sources (budget with a future normal-tree policy unaudited). Same-tag kit effects all apply and add (\u00a73b): two live 40% IDG buffs add 80% of the staged base, Gate and Bulwark DDT at 42% remove 84% (70% without the tree), and the bloodline passive multiplies on top. Overlap uptime and AP were not modelled.","No combat simulation: non-dominance of the 14 allocations and the row-weighted totals are arithmetic over per-row additions, not evidence of equal combat strength. AoE target counts (Heart and Cataract circles, Corona spiral), the Cage stun, Tomb's buff prevention, uptime, AP and the Bulwark move row were not modelled. No adverse, hidden, mode-restricted or injected rows exist here."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":7,"afterburn":10,"lifesteal":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":16,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":1,"damage":5,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"increasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":3,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Godstorm Eclipse classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Godstorm Eclipse jutsu inherit Godstorm Eclipse potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this g.text: Draft 2 / Godstorm Eclipse classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Godstorm Eclipse jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Horizon Gate · Sky-Splitting Wall · Storm-God's Heart · Tempest ·
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Pillar of Heaven path + Black Sun Rising
Eater of Suns path + Black Sun Rising
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
